test_ssl_cert_env_var_respected: test the _load_ensure_ssl function respects an existing SSL_CERT_FILE environment variable
test_ssl_default_paths_used: test _ensure_ssl_certs sets SSL_CERT_FILE from ssl.get_default_verify_paths when no env var is set
test_no_op_when_no_certs_found: test _ensure_ssl_certs does nothing when no certificate sources are available
test_certifi_fallback_used: test _ensure_ssl_certs falls back to certifi.where() when system paths are unavailable
test_hardcoded_paths_fallback: test _ensure_ssl_certs falls back to /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt when other sources fail
